pages.text:
Progress Test Files 1–4
Listening 1
Nick
Where are you from, Mojca?
Mojca I’m from Ljubljana. It’s the capital city of Slovenia.
Nick
Oh, right. Is it a big city?
Mojca Well, it’s our capital city but it isn’t very big. A lot of
tourists come in the summer so it’s busy in the centre. But
it’s small, really.
Nick
Do you live there?
Mojca No, not at the moment. My parents live there. And my
brother. But I live in a small town 20 kilometres from the
city. I often go to Ljubljana at the weekend. The bars and
restaurants are very good and you can sit near the river
and watch people.
Nick
What do people do in the summer in Ljubljana?
Mojca Well, a lot of people leave the city in the summer. They go
to the beach or they go to the mountains. The mountains
in the north of the country are very beautiful.
Nick
And in the winter?
Mojca Well, it’s very cold in the winter. We often stay at home and
watch TV! We eat a lot of food and drink Slovenian wine,
which is very good. But some people go to the mountains.
You can ski there in the winter.
Nick
Thanks for telling me about your country, Mojca. It was
very interesting.
Progress Test Files 1–4
Listening 2
1
Jane
Is that your car, Joe?
Joe
The blue one?
Jane
Yes. The fast, expensive sports car.
Joe
Mmm. Well, no. It’s the red car over there.
Jane
Oh, right. The old car.
2
Karen
Look Dan. This is a photo of my sister.
Dan
Oh, right. Is she married?
Karen
Oh, why do you want to know that?
Dan
Er … well …
Karen
Well, she isn’t. And she doesn’t have a boyfriend.
3
Penny
What do you have for breakfast, James?
James
Well, I usually have cereal, juice, and a cup of tea. Most
people drink coffee for breakfast but not me. I don’t like
it.
4
Jessica
What do you do, Paul?
Paul
I’m a waiter. In a hotel restaurant.
Jessica
Oh, so do you work evenings? Waiters I know often work
until late at night.
Paul
I know. But not me. I usually work breakfasts and lunches
so I’m at work early in the morning and in the afternoon,
but never late.
5
Wendy What time do you usually go to bed?
Ron
Oh, in the week I always go to bed at half past ten. I get up
early and I like to get my sleep, but it’s different at
weekends.
Wendy Oh, so do you go to bed later then?
Ron
Well, yes. At eleven thirty. So, only an hour later.
